mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 75 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. Under a waxing crescent moon, we have no rain in the forecast as the temperature drops to a low of 61 degrees overnight. Keep your eyes peeled at 4:47 AM for the space station pass, which will be visible from the south over Belleville heading east toward Fitchburg.
The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various roles, and construction on Highway M is set to begin this Tuesday with traffic shifts expected.
There is a busy lineup today with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, along with a Girls Try Hockey session. Tomorrow, check out the UGM event at Epic or try a yoga class.
In the weekly recap, on August 8, officers utilized a drone to successfully locate a suspect involved in a burglary who had fled into a corn field.
Enjoy the refreshing Mint Cookie flavor of the day at Culver's. The store is open until 10 PM, giving you plenty of time to grab a treat.
